notes.title: Drawful 2: International Update
notes.notes:
An update for [i]Drawful 2[/i] is available now! The new update adds in four additional language options. Players can now enjoy their drawing attempts in German, French, Italian, and Spanish! The International Update is available now as a free digital download for all current [i]Drawful 2[/i] owners. You can buy Drawful 2 today right here on Steam!

[previewyoutube=HzfSj61fohQ;full][/previewyoutube]

This update also includes:
[list]
[*]Custom episodes! 
Players will have the ability to create their own [i]Drawful 2[/i] episodes with user-generated prompts!
[*]Closed-captioning
Players will be able to turn on subtitles for the host audio!
[*]Content moderation
We’re bringing the new moderation features from The Jackbox Party Pack 7! Moderators will be able to join the game by going to mod.jackbox.tv and entering the room code. By doing this, they will be able to see all prompts and drawings before they appear on screen and remove any from appearing in the game. This is especially useful for streamers and content creators.
[*]Text filtering
By turning on this setting, the game will automatically filter out offensive content and/or hate speech. There are three settings available for filtering: Off, Moderate, and Strict. 
[/list]
The International Update is available as a free digital download for owners of Drawful 2 right here on Steam. More information on the game and the entire Jackbox Games lineup can be found on [url=https://www.jackboxgames.com/drawful-two/]our website[/url].

notes.title: Free Drawful 2 Update!
notes.notes:
Starting May 6th, Drawful 2 will be receiving a free update which includes full localizations for French, Italian, German, and Spanish! This update will be available for anyone who already owns Drawful 2 here on Steam for free. We’ve also added some quality of life features such as closed captioning, content moderation, and text filtering! Visit [url=www.jackboxgames.com]our website[/url] for more information, and if you don’t already own Drawful 2, buy it today here on Steam!

---
